digest.component_or_area: dependency management and Python environment provisioning
propositions: uv's universal resolution locks all extras jointly, causing boto3 version disjointness between [eval] (pins boto3<1.40.62 via aiobotocore) and [bedrock]/[dev] (require boto3>=1.42.63), which downgrades pydantic-ai-slim to 1.38.0 that cannot import AnthropicModel from anthropic 0.120.2+.

pydantic_ai.models.anthropic expects UserLocation from anthropic.types.beta.beta_web_search_tool_20250305_param, which does not exist in anthropic 0.120.2, causing import failure at runtime when pydantic-ai-slim 1.38.0 is installed alongside newer anthropic.

pip-provisioned environments are unaffected because pip installs one extra set at a time and [dev]/[agents] never co-resolve with [eval]'s boto3 constraints, allowing the correct pair (pydantic-ai-slim 1.107.1 + anthropic 0.120.2).

The fix is to declare [tool.uv] conflicts for eval⊥bedrock and eval⊥dev, plus raise the [agents] floor to pydantic-ai-slim[anthropic,retries]>=1.107,<2, so uv resolves to pydantic-ai-slim 1.107.1 with compatible anthropic.

CI and local install paths must honor the lock via uv sync --locked (or equivalent) with a uv lock --check gate to prevent drift; a smoke test asserting AnthropicModel imports validates the fix in the locked environment.
